notes.glasses: Prescription glasses allowed only if no glare, reflection, or frames covering eyes. Sunglasses forbidden.
notes.smile: Neutral facial expression, closed mouth, eyes directed at camera.
notes.ears: Hair should be tucked behind ears or away from face so facial edges are clearly distinct.
notes.shadows: No shadows on face, background, or shoulders.
notes.babyRules: Babies under one year old do not need to keep their eyes open, but must be supported invisibly.
